svg.title: Fig. 03 — Immune Patrol
svg.desc: Each square is one day of Dr2b's GitHub contributions, drawn as tissue. 7 antigens appear and spread to neighbouring days; a phagocyte hunts them down and contains all 22. A new outbreak is generated every day.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: tissue: the last year of my contributions
